Julio —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. Helpful. We typically do the following so we can automate pay routing and remittance reconciliation: 

- PO format: Please include PO number in this pattern on every invoice: PO-<RedwoodAcct>-<SupplierID>-<INVYYYYMMDD>. Example: PO-RW-5829-SB-20280615. That helps our invoice matching.
- Verification: We prefer ACH micro-deposit verification plus a signed bank letter on file. We will initiate two micro-deposits to the account on file; please confirm you can see and report the exact cents so we can verify.
- Wires: For wire sends we will reference the same account and include the invoice PO string in the wire remittance narrative. No further action required unless the bank asks for additional beneficiary details.
- Remittance file: Our finance team expects a simple CSV with these headers: invoice_number, invoice_date, invoice_amount, po_reference, supplier_account_id, remit_notes. I can attach a one-line sample CSV after we confirm micro-deposits.

Next steps for Stonebridge:
1) Confirm you can receive micro-deposits and will reply with the amounts once they land.
2) If you can, please return a signed bank letter (notarized if possible).
3) Provide a contact for AP (name/email) who will receive remittance confirmation files.

Cc'ing Marissa (Finance) and Priyom (PayOps) to watch the thread and trigger verification.

Thanks — I will kick off the micro-deposit from Redwood Payments today (Redwood Payments <noreply-payments@redwood.com>). Expect two small deposits within 24-48 hours.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Platform Partnerships — Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
